articleTitle: SEC Unveils New Crypto Custody Framework to Fill Regulatory Gap

sources.title: U.S. SEC maps out crypto custody in new proposal that furthers its digital assets agenda - Cryptonews.net
SEC maps out crypto custody in new proposal that furthers its digital assets agenda - CoinDesk

claims.claim: The SEC’s latest proposal explicitly states it will “provide a clear regulatory framework for the custody of crypto assets, giving investment advisers and funds a compliant pathway where none existed before.” This marks the first time the agency has offered a specific route for advisers to hold digital‑asset holdings, a gap that has left many firms uncertain about compliance.

claims.claim: The proposal also includes a rule that requires an adviser to prove no qualified custodian is available before self‑custody is permitted, and it mandates that firms demonstrate specific expertise in managing crypto assets.
